items.heading: Muamba de Galinha
details: Key ingredients: chicken, palm oil, okra, garlic, chili
Marinate chicken pieces with garlic and lemon.
Simmer the chicken in palm oil with chili and aromatics until fragrant.
Add okra partway through cooking to thicken the sauce.
Serve the rich chicken stew over funge or rice.

items.heading: Calulu
details: Key ingredients: dried fish, eggplant, sweet potato leaves, palm oil
Soak dried fish and smoked meat to soften.
Simmer the fish and meat with eggplant and leafy greens.
Stir in palm oil and season to taste.
Serve the stew hot with a side of funge or rice.
